outline:
Objective: The practice of building computer simulation models to represent existing real-world systems, or hypothetical future systems, and of experimenting with these models to explain system behavior, improve system performance, or design new systems with desirable performances.

Project:
1. Term project is individual. Topic is not limited in any domain of interests, but a real world case study is preferred. Project abstract must be submitted (11/17) in no more than two pages (A4), which includes topic, abstract, research objective, feasibility and expected result.
2. The project is supposed to be outlined as below:
a. Introduction (Why this topic?)
b. Research Questions and Methodology
c. The ARENA Model
c. Simulation Design and Data Analysis
d. Conclusion and future recommendations
e. Reference (if any)
4. Project must be typed.
5. Hard copy as well as CD-ROM needs to be submitted before deadline.
